description: The Attestation RP rejects a PUT without the connection's ARM `id` (400 `Null PrivateEndpointConnection.Id`), and the converted model strips the read-only `id` fields from the request. Add the connection `id` to the body and the private endpoint `id` to PrivateEndpointInput.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Fully qualified ARM resource ID of the private endpoint connection. Required by the service.
The ARM identifier for Private Endpoint.
